shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: I currently have equal amounts of A, B, and C. Trading 1 A for 1 B would reduce variety by leaving me with no A and extra B, which lowers my utility.

Trading 1 B for 1 A changes my inventory from (A1, B1, C1) to (A2, B0, C1). Since I value all goods equally but prefer goods I have less of, losing B makes B become my scarcest good, which reduces variety. This does not increase my utility, so I should reject.

Giving 1 B and receiving 2 A changes my inventory from (A1,B1,C1) to (A3,B0,C1). Since all goods are equally valued and I prefer variety, this reduces variety and makes my holdings more imbalanced, so it does not increase my utility.
